name: Materialious | Modern YouTube Client on Your Own Invidious
description: Material Design YouTube client with your own Invidious backend
card_desc: Materialious: a modern Material Design YouTube client on your own Invidious. Accounts with synced subscriptions and history, SponsorBlock, DeArrow and dislike counts, watch parties. Bundles Invidious, Companion and Postgres; sign-ups close after the admin registers.
